title: A phishing page interested in MX records, (Tue, Nov 17th)
description: A phishing campaign uses a credential-harvesting page that collects not only victims' passwords but also additional information including public IP, geolocation, browser details, and notably, MX records of the victim's email domain via DNS-over-HTTPS queries. The MX records are included with stolen credentials to help attackers identify the victim organization's email infrastructure, potentially aiding further attacks or prioritization of stolen data. The phishing page is hosted on Google Cloud Storage and personalizes the login form using the victim's email domain. This behavior represents an enhanced reconnaissance step embedded in the phishing process.
